info.title: Solar Generation API
info.description: Implemented endpoints: application liveness, OpenAPI, user/admin and device JWT exchange, and jurisdiction-scoped province lists. Active installations can submit append-only readings. Users can retrieve individual readings within their stored jurisdiction. Users can page and filter installation reading history within current jurisdiction. Current database admins can create active installations with independently supplied device credentials. Current admins can activate or deactivate installations with atomic optional If-Match preconditions. Admins can permanently delete installations without readings using atomic optional If-Match and ingestion coordination.

get.description: Public endpoint. Does not check MongoDB or other dependencies. Supports If-None-Match using a stable strong ETag. Accepts no query parameters; any supplied query parameter returns 400 INVALID_QUERY.

post.summary: Exchange user/admin credentials for a short-lived JWT
post.description: Accept only email and password. Normalize email by trimming/lowercasing; preserve the password exactly. Claims come from the current MongoDB User: sub (public UUID), actor=user, role, readScope, optional provinceId or districtId; admins also receive installation-create, installation-status-update, installation-delete in permissions. HS256 signatures include configured iss, aud, iat, and exp. No refresh token. Responses are not cacheable. Validly shaped attempts use shared MongoDB limits of 5 per 15 minutes by IP and normalized account email. No passwords, hashes, or internal IDs are returned. Accepts no query parameters; any supplied query parameter returns 400 INVALID_QUERY.

400.description: Malformed JSON or invalid request fields. Any supplied query parameter also returns INVALID_QUERY.

Request body must be valid JSON.

get.summary: List provinces visible to the current user
get.description: Return the complete jurisdiction-scoped count/items collection without pagination or query parameters. National users/admins see all provinces; provincial users only their assigned province; district users only their current assigned district's parent province. Missing/broken assigned ancestry returns an empty collection. Sort by name then public UUID. Authenticate/reload current User and apply the shared 120/minute read limit before query rejection, snapshot reads and conditional handling. Any supplied query parameter returns 400 INVALID_QUERY. Private principal-scoped strong ETag; no Last-Modified. Accepts no query parameters; any supplied query parameter returns 400 INVALID_QUERY.

post.summary: Exchange meter credentials for a short-lived installation JWT
post.description: Accept only nonempty meterId and deviceSecret strings, preserving both exactly. Verify the submitted secret against the stored salted scrypt hash; never derive a secret from the development prefix. Unknown meters and secret mismatches share a generic 401. Correct credentials for inactive installations return 403. Active installations receive sub (installation public UUID), actor=installation and scope=installation-write with the same configured HS256, iss, aud and lifetime as user tokens. No user authorization or internal IDs are included. All responses use no-store. Validly shaped attempts use shared MongoDB counters: 5 per 15 minutes per IP and exact meter ID, separate from user-login counters. Reading submission is not implemented. Accepts no query parameters; any supplied query parameter returns 400 INVALID_QUERY.

post.summary: Submit an append-only reading for the authenticated active installation
post.description: Accept exactly four input fields. UUID, installation binding and receivedAt are server controlled. Authentication/ownership and body validation precede shared limits of 30/minute per installation and per IP. All responses are no-store. Active status is rechecked with a parent write inside the insertion transaction; lifecycle conflicts retry with current status/existence. Duplicate timestamps never overwrite history. Accepts no query parameters; any supplied query parameter returns 400 INVALID_QUERY.

get.summary: Page and filter authorized installation reading history
get.description: Current stored user jurisdiction is checked before readings, count, paging or validators. National analysts/admins read nationally; provincial/district analysts read within assigned ancestry. Inactive installation history remains readable. Count and page are read in one snapshot. Stable sort uses recordedAt and publicId in the same direction, default newest first. Shared read limit is 120/minute per user including conditional requests. ETag covers user context, installation, normalized paging/sort, filters and complete response. No Last-Modified is sent because no reliable revision exists for the collection envelope; If-Modified-Since alone cannot return 304. Denied/error responses contain neither data/counts nor ETag/Last-Modified.

get.summary: Read an individual installation reading within current user jurisdiction
get.description: Requires user/admin JWT authentication and current stored jurisdiction. Resolve installation, substation, district and province before reading lookup or validators. National analysts/admins read nationally; provincial/district analysts read only within assigned ancestry. Inactive installations retain readable history. Find readings by both installationId and readingId. Existing installations outside current jurisdiction return 403 before reading lookup; missing ancestry/resources and reading/installation mismatches return 404. Shared user-read limit is 120/minute per user, including admins and conditional requests. The exact public JSON and strong ETag match POST; private caching and authorization on each request prevent validators bypassing access. Accepts no query parameters; any supplied query parameter returns 400 INVALID_QUERY.

get.summary: Page and filter reading history within stored jurisdiction
get.description: Current user authentication and shared 120/minute read limit precede scoped reading queries and conditional responses. National analysts/admins read nationally; provincial/district analysts see only their stored area. Include inactive installations. Resolve explicit geography and ancestry: missing resources return 404, outside-jurisdiction filters 403, and contradictory authorized filters 400. Selecting a district analyst's parent province never broadens district scope. Count/page and authorized geography share a snapshot. Reuse recordedAt/publicId sort and public reading fields. Links preserve all filters. ETag covers current principal, effective query and complete response; matching If-None-Match returns bodyless 304 after authorization. Omit unreliable Last-Modified; If-Modified-Since alone returns 200. Errors expose no data/counts or validators.

get.summary: Retrieve the latest measurement within the current user jurisdiction
get.description: Require current user authentication (installation tokens return 401), shared 120/minute User read limits, valid installation UUID and complete ancestry authorization before reading lookup or conditional GET. National analysts/admins read nationally; provincial/district analysts within stored jurisdiction; cross-jurisdiction access returns 403 even with empty history. Missing installation/ancestry or no readings returns 404. Include inactive history. Select greatest recordedAt (descending publicId tie-breaker), never greatest receivedAt. Return the existing public reading representation with exact strong ETag, private, no-cache and Last-Modified from the selected immutable receivedAt at whole-second precision. If-None-Match takes precedence; matching conditions return bodyless 304. A delayed older measurement preserves validators; a newer measurement changes ETag. Errors use no-store and omit reading validators. Accepts no query parameters; any supplied query parameter returns 400 INVALID_QUERY.

get.summary: Retrieve installation details, related geography and latest measurement

National analysts/admins read nationally; provincial/district analysts within stored jurisdiction. Cross-jurisdiction access returns 403, missing installation/ancestry 404. Include inactive installations. Read the complete composite in one snapshot. latestReading selects greatest recordedAt with descending publicId tie-breaker, or null for empty history; no full history. Strong ETag covers the current principal and complete composite, including latest-reading, installation status and geography changes. Private, no-cache; matching If-None-Match returns bodyless 304 after authorization. Omit Last-Modified because no reliable whole-composite revision time exists; If-Modified-Since alone returns 200. Errors use no-store without validators. Accepts no query parameters; any supplied query parameter returns 400 INVALID_QUERY.

Return active/inactive installation metadata only: id, substationId, meterId and status. Strong ETag is the quoted SHA-256 digest of JSON.stringify of public fields in that order, independent of principal identity and suitable for admin If-Match. No reliable metadata modification time exists, so omit Last-Modified; If-Modified-Since alone returns 200. Errors use no-store without validators. patch.summary: Activate or deactivate an installation as an administrator
patch.description: Require valid user JWT and current database admin role; wrong actors return 401 and non-admins 403. Accept exactly one status field with value active or inactive; preserve identity, credentials, ancestry and all readings. Repeating the current status returns the unchanged public representation and ETag. After authentication, authorization, path/body validation and the shared 30/minute admin-write limit, resolve the installation before evaluating optional If-Match. Absent header is unconditional; sole * matches an existing installation; a quoted tag list succeeds if any strong tag matches the canonical detail ETag. Weak tags never match. Malformed headers return 400; mismatch returns 412 even for no-op status updates. Compare and update in a snapshot/majority transaction with a real shared installation write, including no-op PATCH; conflicts retry and re-evaluate the current ETag. Coordinate with reading ingestion: after deactivation, device login and further writes (including stale tokens) fail. All responses use no-store; errors omit validators. Reactivation restores device login and writes. Previously issued device tokens work only until their original expiry; expired tokens remain invalid. Guarded deletion uses its separate endpoint. Accepts no query parameters; any supplied query parameter returns 400 INVALID_QUERY.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional strong detail ETag comparison. Quoted tag list (any strong match) or sole *. Weak tags do not match; malformed syntax 400, mismatch 412, missing resource 404 first.

200.description: Requested active/inactive status applied, or already set; public representation and resulting strong ETag. No Last-Modified.

400.description: Invalid public installation UUID, body other than exactly one status field with active or inactive, malformed If-Match (INVALID_REQUEST), or malformed JSON (INVALID_JSON). Any supplied query parameter also returns INVALID_QUERY.

412.description: Existing installation does not strongly match If-Match (PRECONDITION_FAILED), including an otherwise no-op PATCH; no mutation.

delete.summary: Delete an installation with no readings as an administrator
delete.description: Require user JWT and current database admin role; device/invalid tokens 401, non-admins 403. Validate public UUID and reject any request body, including non-JSON/streamed payloads; Content-Type is not required. Share the POST/PATCH 30 writes/minute per-admin counter after validation. Resolve missing installation 404 before parsing/evaluating optional If-Match using the same strong rules as PATCH. Malformed syntax 400, mismatch 412; preconditions precede history guard. Within a snapshot/majority transaction force a real write to the same installation as reading ingestion, then check history and delete only this installation if empty, regardless of active/inactive status. Reading history returns 409 INSTALLATION_HAS_READINGS and rolls back lock writes. Conflicts retry existence, preconditions and history; no orphan readings or cascade deletion. Success 204 has no body or resource validators; repeat deletion 404. Old installation tokens fail verification; re-registering the meter generates a new UUID. Responses use no-store; errors omit validators/private diagnostics. Accepts no query parameters; any supplied query parameter returns 400 INVALID_QUERY.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional strong detail ETag comparison. Quoted tag list (any strong match) or sole *. Weak tags do not match; malformed syntax 400, mismatch 412, missing resource 404 first.

204.description: Empty active or inactive installation permanently deleted; no body, Content-Type, ETag or Last-Modified.

400.description: Invalid installation UUID, any request body, malformed If-Match (INVALID_REQUEST), or malformed JSON (INVALID_JSON). Any supplied query parameter also returns INVALID_QUERY.

409.description: Installation has one or more readings (INSTALLATION_HAS_READINGS); installation and all history retained. Evaluated after If-Match.

412.description: Existing installation fails the strong If-Match comparison (PRECONDITION_FAILED); no mutation. Takes precedence over the history guard.

get.summary: List public installations within the current user jurisdiction
get.description: Require current user authentication (installation tokens return 401), shared 120/minute user-read limits and authorized geography before installation count/page/validators. National analysts/admins list nationally; provincial/district analysts within stored jurisdiction. Explicit outside-scope geography returns 403; missing geography/ancestry 404; contradictory authorized or invalid filters 400. A district analyst may select their parent province without expanding scope. Accept geography UUID filters, optional status=active|inactive and offset/limit. Omission includes both statuses. Apply status within authorized geography before count/page; preserve it in pagination links and validator context. Order by publicId ascending. Empty results return 200 with an empty collection. Read geography/count/page in one snapshot. ETag covers current principal, effective query and complete envelope; private, no-cache. Matching If-None-Match returns bodyless 304 after authorization/rate limiting. No reliable whole-collection Last-Modified exists; If-Modified-Since alone returns 200. Errors use no-store without validators/items/counts. Installation creation and active/inactive status updates are implemented; Guarded empty-installation deletion is implemented.

The unique meter index covers both statuses and concurrent inserts. After authorization and validation, consume shared 30 writes/minute per admin; valid-shaped failures also count. All responses use no-store; errors omit validators. Guarded empty-installation deletion is implemented. Accepts no query parameters; any supplied query parameter returns 400 INVALID_QUERY.

get.summary: Summarize current power and observed daily energy for an authorized district
get.description: Require current user authentication (installation tokens 401) and shared 120/minute User read limits. Accept exactly one required public UUID v4 districtId query parameter and no other options; missing/invalid/repeated parameters return 400. Missing district or ancestry returns 404; authorize national/admin, assigned province or assigned district before aggregate queries or validators. Capture asOf once per request, including transaction retries. Current power sums each active installation latest recordedAt at or before asOf, if within the inclusive 30-minute freshness window; active installations without eligible readings count as stale. Use Asia/Colombo midnight through asOf inclusive for energy. todayEnergyKwh is observed daily energy that may be incomplete: sum nonnegative consecutive counter differences per installation, including inactive history, skipping decreases and resuming from each lower counter. Use an exact midnight baseline if available; otherwise start at the first in-day sample and flag incomplete. No interpolation, extrapolation, pre-midnight baseline or estimation. Fewer than two daily readings, missing midnight baseline or any decrease counts that installation as incomplete once. Empty districts return zero totals/counts. Read ancestry, status and history in one snapshot. ETag covers current principal and complete response including asOf; private, no-cache. The asOf field uses DD Mon YYYY, hh:mm AM/PM (Sri Lanka), while calculations retain full precision. ETag changes when the displayed timestamp or calculated values change, including freshness expiry and midnight without new readings. Matching If-None-Match yields bodyless 304 only after access/rate checks. Omit Last-Modified; If-Modified-Since alone returns 200. Errors are no-store without validators.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Strong/weak matching tag, quoted tag list, or * returns bodyless 304 after authorization. Takes precedence over If-Modified-Since.

parameters.name: If-Modified-Since
parameters.description: Ignored because no reliable change time covers this time-dependent summary; alone returns 200.

304.description: Authorized complete summary including asOf unchanged; no body or Content-Type

get.summary: List all public installations connected to an authorized grid substation
get.description: Require current user authentication (installation tokens return 401), shared 120/minute user-read limits and public UUID v4 substationId (invalid path 400). Resolve requested substation and complete ancestry, then authorize national/admin, assigned province or assigned district access before installation queries/counts/validators. Missing substation or ancestry returns 404; outside jurisdiction 403. Return all installations connected to the URL substation, including active and inactive, with public id/substationId/meterId/status. Reuse existing installation-list query logic and serializer, without pagination. Accept no query parameters: offset, limit, geography, sorting and all other options return 400 INVALID_QUERY. Fixed ascending public UUID order. Response has count and items only; no next/previous fields or pagination links. Empty authorized collections return 200 with count=0 and items=[]. Resolve geography/count/results in one snapshot. Strong ETag covers current principal, parent substation and complete response; private, no-cache. Matching If-None-Match returns bodyless 304 after access/rate checks. Omit Last-Modified; If-Modified-Since alone returns 200. Errors use no-store without data/counts/validators. Accepts no query parameters; any supplied query parameter returns 400 INVALID_QUERY.

ReadingETag.description: Strong validator of the exact public reading JSON, identical to its POST validator.

InstallationETag.description: Strong quoted SHA-256 digest of canonical public installation JSON (id, substationId, meterId, status); independent of reader, readings and private metadata. Shared with admin If-Match operations.
